# AI PR Review Rules: miso-gallery

The detailed security checklist now lives in the trusted-base skill
[.agents/skills/media-security-review/SKILL.md](../.agents/skills/media-security-review/SKILL.md).

The native reviewer catalogs .agents/skills/*/SKILL.md when
repository-skills: "true" is enabled. Read this skill for changes involving
uploads, media serving, filesystem paths, authentication, rate limiting,
subprocesses, or image processing. AGENTS.md remains the general project guide.
